questions.question: The total number of articles sold by seller C to Shopkeeper Q is what percent of the total number of articles sold by seller F to the shopkeeper P?
questions.solution:
Number of articles sold by seller C to shopkeeper Q is = 49

Number of articles sold by seller F to shopkeeper P is = 55

Required percentage = 49/55 × 100 = 89.09%

questions.question: What is the difference between total articles sold to P and Q by all the sellers other than A, B, C, D, E and F?
questions.solution:
Articles sold to P by all the sellers other than A, B, C, D, E and F = 300 – (45 + 53 + 28 + 38 + 35 + 55) = 300 – 254 = 46

Articles sold to Q by all the sellers other than A, B, C, D, E and F = 500 – (56 + 49 + 49 + 38 + 65 + 60) = 500 – 317 = 183

Required difference = 183 – 46 = 137

questions.question: A man goes to a place on the car at a speed of 160 km/h and comes back at a lower speed. If the average speed is 64km/h in total, then return speed (in km/h) is:
questions.solution:
Let return speed of man be x, Average speed = 64 km/hr

As we know,

Average speed = 2xy/(x + y)

⇒ 64 = (2 × 160 × x)/(160 + x)

⇒ 160 + x = 320x/64

⇒ 160 + x = 5x

⇒ 4x = 160

⇒ x = 160/4

⇒ x = 40 km/hr

questions.question: The ratio of cost price and selling price of an article is c : d. If d is 150% of c then the profit percentage on cost price is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of cost price and selling price of an article is c : d. 

d is 150% of c

**Formula:**

Profit% = (Selling price - Cost price)/Cost price × 100

**Calculation:**

Let c be Rs. 100

⇒ d = 100 × 150/100 = Rs. 150

Profit = 150 – 100 = 50

Profit % = 50/100 × 100 = 50%

**∴ profit% = 50%**&l

questions.question: The price that Kamal should mark on a chair which costs him Rs. 1500 to gain 15% after allowing a discount of 25% (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of the chair = Rs. 1500

Gain = 15%

Discount = 25%

**Formula used:**

M.P = {C.P × (100 + markup%)}/100%

S.P = {M.P × (100 - discount%)}/100%

Discount% = {(M.P - S.P)/M.P} × 100%

Profit% = {(S.P - C.P)/C.P} × 100%

Where M.P = Marked price, S.P = Selling price, C.P = Cost price

**Calculation:**

Cost price = Rs. 1500

Gain = 15%

⇒ Profit = 0.15 × 1500 = 225

Selling price = Cost price + Profit

⇒ Selling price = 1500 + 225 = Rs. 1725

Let, Marked price be x

Given, Discount = 25%

⇒ Selling price = Marked price – Discount

⇒ 1725 = x – 0.25x

⇒ 0.75x = 1725

⇒ x = Rs. 2300

∴ Marked price is Rs. 2300

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Cost price of the chair = Rs. 1500

SP of the chair = Rs. 1500 × 115/100

MP of the chair = 1500 × 115/100 × 100/75 = 230

questions.question: In an office, there are 216 tables and 264 chairs. If 1/6 of the tables and 1/4 of the chairs are broken then how many people can work in the office if each person requires one table and one chair?
questions.solution:
Number of fresh table = 216 × 5/6 = 180

Number of fresh chair = 264 × 3/4 = 198

If each person requires one table and one chair then number of required persons = 180

questions.question: A and B together can complete some work in 36 days, B and C together can complete the same work in 60 days, A and C together can complete the same work in 45 days. In how many days B alone can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Diagram**

Total work = 180

Efficiency of A + B + C = (5 + 3 + 4)/2 = 6

Efficiency of B = 6 – 4 = 2

B alone can complete the whole work in = 180/2 = 90 days

questions.question: A sold his pen at a profit of Rs. 13. He calculated the profit percentage on selling price and found it to be 20%. The cost price (in Rs) of the pen is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit = Rs. 13

Profit percent on SP = 20%

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

Profit % on SP = (Profit/SP) × 100

CP = SP – Profit

CP is Cost Price and SP is Selling Price

**Calculation:**

Profit % on SP = (Profit/SP) × 100

20 = (13/SP) × 100

⇒ SP = 65

CP = SP – Profit = 65 – 13 = 52

**∴ Cost price of pen is Rs. 52**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] **

Let SP of the pen be 5 unit 

Profit on the pen = 5 × 1/5 = 1 unit

CP of the pen = 4 unit

⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 13

⇒ 4 unit = 13 × 4 = Rs. 52

∴ Cost price of pen is Rs. 52

questions.question: Each wheel of a bus is making 7 revolutions per second. If the diameter of a wheel is 56 cm, then the speed of the bus (in cm/sec) would be:
questions.solution:
Radius of the wheel r = 56/2 = 28 cm

Circumference of the wheel = 2πr = 2 × 22/7 × 28 = 176 cm

Distance covered by the wheel in 1 revolution = 176

Distance covered by wheel in 7 revolutions = 176 × 7 = 1232 cm

Speed of bus = 1232 cm/sec

questions.question: If l : m : n = 1 : 2 : 4, then sqrt {frac{ {5{l²} + {m²} + {n²}}}{l²}} is equal to:
Out of four numbers, the average of the first three is 16 and that of the last three is 15. If the last number is 21 then the first number is:
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

Average = Sum of observation / Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The last 3 numbers total = 3 × 15 = 45

So the middle 2 numbers will add to 45 – 21 = 24

First 3 numbers total = 3 × 16 = 48

So the first number is 48 – 24 = 24

∴ The first number is 24

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

There are four numbers A, B, C and D

Average of first 3 numbers = 16

Sum of first 3 numbers = 16 × 3 = 48

⇒ A + B + C = 48 --- (1)

Average of last 3 numbers = 15

Sum of last 3 numbers = 3 × 15 = 45

⇒ B + C + D = 45 --- (2)

Subtract equation (2) from equation (1)

⇒ A – D = 48 – 45

⇒ A – D = 3

⇒ A – 21 = 3 (∵ D = 21)

⇒ A = 3 + 21 = 24

**∴ The first number is 24**

questions.question: Two trains each having length of 160 meters moving in the opposite direction crossed each other in 9 seconds. If one train crossed a 200-meter-long platform in 18 seconds, then the ratio of their speeds is:
questions.solution:
Length of each train is 160 m

Let speed of first and second train be x m/sec and y m/sec respectively.

As we know,

Speed = Distance/time

⇒ x = (160 + 200)/18

⇒ x = 360/18

⇒ x = 20 m/sec

⇒ (x + y) = (160 + 160)/9

⇒ 9 (20 + y) = 320

⇒ 180 + 9y = 320

⇒ 9y = 320 – 180

⇒ y = 140/9 m/sec

Speed ratio of x : y = 20 : 140/9 = 9 : 7
